description: This Java class 'MockServerExtension' implements JUnit 5 extension interfaces to manage MockServer instances for testing, including setup and teardown logic, parameter resolution, and configuration based on annotations.

classes.name: MockServerExtension
classes.description: A JUnit 5 extension for managing MockServer lifecycle during tests, supporting parameter injection and setup/teardown.

methods.name: MockServerExtension
methods.description: Constructor accepting a custom ClientAndServer instance.

methods.name: supportsParameter
methods.description: Determines if a parameter can be resolved to a MockServerClient.

methods.name: resolveParameter
methods.description: Provides the ClientAndServer instance for test injection.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initializes the MockServer before all tests, configuring ports and settings.

methods.name: instantiateClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a ClientAndServer instance based on configuration.

methods.name: afterAll
methods.description: Stops the ClientAndServer after all tests if applicable.

methods.name: retrieveAnnotationFromTestClass
methods.description: Retrieves MockServerSettings annotation from test class hierarchy.
